# NftyMetadata

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public record NftyMetadata
```

Rich nfty-specific per-item metadata. Written to `nfty/NNNN.json` alongside the OpenSea file so the OpenSea file stays standards-pure. Carries the generator's extras.
